title: OpenCMO capability registry
description: Every Studio entry point and every CMO job, with what it does, who approves it and who may call it (docs/architecture/brain.md §7). apps/web/lib/cmo/capabilities.check.ts validates capabilities.json against the same rules in check:contracts.

name.description: The tool, op or job name as the code calls it.

effect.description: read: changes nothing; write: changes the founder's own data; spend: holds credits; outbound: reaches a platform.

approval.description: none: runs as asked; founder: a card the founder decides; price: a card that shows the price before anything is spent.

callers.description: Who may call it. The brain gets no private path: a caller not listed here is refused by check:contracts.

order_kind.description: The work_orders.kind it runs under; null when it never runs as an order.

max_steps.description: Effort budget: steps one run may take.

credits.description: The fixed price, or quote when the price comes from the plan (shown on the card).

input.description: The name of the input type or schema in code.
